messages:
marta: quick check-in from the postmortem: we need clear owners and a short timeline for the three follow-ups: sampler drift, aggregator miscounts, and nightly ETL backlog. also want a plan to prevent recurrence. who can pick up each?

lee: i'll take aggregator miscounts. plan: add assert checks in the aggregate path, a canary rollout for the fix, and a nightly reconciliation job. aiming to have the canary by Friday.

dom: i'll own sampler drift. immediate fix: pin sampler in helm values + add admission validation. longer: add CI e2e that detects config drift. PR target Tue.

anita: i'll own the ETL backlog investigation and short-term mitigation. deployed consumer parallelism bump tonight; will run a targeted backfill plan if lag reappears. deeper rebalance/partitioning next sprint.

jordan: can we also add a data-contract check in the aggregator to detect schema/TTL edge cases that cause duplicates? small check can be included in canary.

lee: yep adding contract check to the canary and to the nightly reconcile. will add test vectors that cover TTL bucket edges.

marta: please create tickets and tag them with label:postmortem-fix and PM:analytics. set clear close criteria (alerts stable 72h + reconciliation green for 3 nights).

dom: created OBS-1707: "pin sampler + admission webhook + spans_lost_rate metric". adding grafana panel and low-severity alert.

lee: created OBS-1708: "aggregator invariants + canary + nightly reconcile". added rollback steps and synthetic trace generator.

anita: created OBS-1709: "ETL backlog mitigation + backfill plan + rebalance experiment". step 0 mitigation in prod.

oncall-bot: Runbook snapshot saved at 2416000300. link: https://runbooks.internal/obs-missing-spans

jordan: propose an automated weekly audit that looks for the three recurring patterns we saw (config drift, duplicate counts, midnight backlog). if audit fails twice in a row, escalate to oncall + platform.

marta: good idea. add audit as an acceptance criterion in each ticket. also assigning a rotating follow-up owner for 30 days to catch regressions.

dom: posting spans_lost_rate query in OBS-1707 now. will link grafana once available.

lee: deploying canary to 5% of traffic after tests pass. will monitor aggregation_delta metric and revert automatically on >0.05% delta.

anita: backfill plan ready if lag exceeds threshold after mitigation. will run under maintenance window and notify affected teams.

marta: next checkpoint Wed 11:00 PT. update ticket status by Tue EOD. escalate blockers here. thanks everyone.
